question: What spiritual attainment results from completing the prescribed recitation on those days?
premises: The prescribed amount of recitation is completed.
The practitioner becomes fearless and lord of all powers.
inference: Completing the prescribed recitation makes one fearless and master of all powers.
uncertainties: The exact quantity referred to by 'tāvat' depends on the preceding prescription.
plain_english: When that much has been recited, one becomes fearless and lord of all powers.
